title: Detailed aeroplane
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="body" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#f5f7fa"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#c8d6e5"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="wing" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#ff6b6b"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#d63447"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="tail" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#ff9f43"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#e07000"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="engine" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#48dbfb"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#0abde3"/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- Fuselage body -->
  <ellipse cx="48" cy="55" rx="38" ry="9" fill="url(#body)" stroke="#9bb0c4" stroke-width="1.2"/>

  <!-- Nose cone -->
  <ellipse cx="86" cy="55" rx="6" ry="7" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#9bb0c4" stroke-width="1"/>
  <ellipse cx="88" cy="52" rx="3" ry="2.5" fill="#a4e0f7" opacity="0.7"/>

  <!-- Cockpit window -->
  <path d="M78 51 Q82 47 86 51" fill="#74d4f0" stroke="#4aa8c9" stroke-width="0.8"/>
  <path d="M79 51 Q82 48 85 51" fill="#c8f0ff"/>

  <!-- Main wing (bottom) -->
  <path d="M38 62 L18 80 Q25 82 32 79 L52 63 Z" fill="url(#wing)" stroke="#a8283e" stroke-width="1"/>
  <path d="M38 63 L26 76 Q30 77 34 75 L48 64 Z" fill="#ff8a8a" opacity="0.6"/>

  <!-- Upper wing (behind body) -->
  <path d="M42 47 L24 33 Q30 30 38 33 L54 46 Z" fill="#e05555" stroke="#9e2334" stroke-width="1"/>
  <path d="M42 47 L30 36 Q34 34 38 36 L50 46 Z" fill="#ff9e9e" opacity="0.5"/>

  <!-- Engine under wing -->
  <ellipse cx="32" cy="70" rx="7" ry="4.5" fill="url(#engine)" stroke="#0a8ba8" stroke-width="1"/>
  <ellipse cx="35" cy="69" rx="3.5" ry="3" fill="#7ef0ff"/>
  <ellipse cx="28" cy="71" rx="2" ry="1.5" fill="#0a8ba8" opacity="0.5"/>

  <!-- Tail fin -->
  <path d="M12 54 L6 34 Q10 32 16 36 L22 50 Z" fill="url(#tail)" stroke="#b85a00" stroke-width="1"/>
  <path d="M12 53 L8 38 Q10 37 13 39 L18 50 Z" fill="#ffc078" opacity="0.5"/>

  <!-- Horizontal tail stabilizer -->
  <path d="M14 55 L4 46 Q3 49 8 52 L14 57 Z" fill="#e07000" stroke="#a04e00" stroke-width="0.8"/>
  <path d="M14 57 L5 60 Q6 62 10 61 L16 58 Z" fill="#ffb347" stroke="#c08000" stroke-width="0.8"/>

  <!-- Passenger windows -->
  <circle cx="40" cy="54" r="1.6" fill="#74d4f0"/>
  <circle cx="46" cy="54" r="1.6" fill="#74d4f0"/>
  <circle cx="52" cy="54" r="1.6" fill="#74d4f0"/>
  <circle cx="58" cy="54" r="1.6" fill="#74d4f0"/>
  <circle cx="64" cy="54" r="1.6" fill="#74d4f0"/>
  <circle cx="70" cy="54" r="1.6" fill="#74d4f0"/>

  <!-- Door -->
  <rect x="46" y="49" width="3" height="4.5" rx="1" fill="#e8eef5" stroke="#b0c0d0" stroke-width="0.5"/>

  <!-- Cockpit door line -->
  <line x1="76" y1="48" x2="76" y2="60" stroke="#c0ccd8" stroke-width="0.7"/>

  <!-- Engine exhaust -->
  <ellipse cx="25" cy="71" rx="2" ry="1.2" fill="#ff9f43" opacity="0.7"/>

  <!-- Underbelly detail -->
  <path d="M30 58 Q48 62 68 58" stroke="#b0c0d0" stroke-width="0.6" fill="none"/>

  <!-- Small antenna -->
  <line x1="45" y1="48" x2="44" y2="43" stroke="#9bb0c4" stroke-width="0.8"/>
  <circle cx="44" cy="42.5" r="1" fill="#ff6b6b"/>

  <!-- Wing tip light (red) -->
  <circle cx="19" cy="79" r="1.3" fill="#ff3333"/>
  <circle cx="19" cy="79" r="0.6" fill="#ffaaaa"/>

  <!-- Wing tip light (green, other side) -->
  <circle cx="26" cy="35" r="1.3" fill="#33ff66"/>
  <circle cx="26" cy="35" r="0.6" fill="#aaffcc"/>

  <!-- Exhaust trail -->
  <path d="M22 72 Q16 74 12 73" stroke="#48dbfb" stroke-width="1.2" fill="none" opacity="0.6" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M20 69 Q14 70 10 69" stroke="#48dbfb" stroke-width="0.8" fill="none" opacity="0.4" stroke-linecap="round"/>
</svg>
